tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
An ex-Anthropic researcher will testify at a New York City hearing as lawmakers push for safety and whistleblower protections, confirmed by The Edge Malaysia.
A lawsuit is testing who bears responsibility when artificial intelligence agents malfunction, reported by Cyber Magazine.
TrendAI Vision One expanded its Claude API support for artificial intelligence agents, reported by IT Voice Media, adding agent activity monitoring through Claude's Compliance API.
OpenAI launched visual advertisements in ChatGPT along with new measurement tools, reported by The Tech Buzz.
Anthropic's leaked financials show rapid growth but don't support a 2 trillion dollar valuation, reported by Morningstar via PitchBook analysis.
Free every hour.
